title: Diagnostic
description: One diagnostic of a written program under -o json or -o yaml: one JSON text per line on standard error, the records on standard output untouched. A tool decides by severity and code, never by message.

severity.description: usage: the command line or the request document is wrong and nothing was done, exit 2. error: something asked could not be done, exit 1 unless the program defines more.

code.description: The errno name (EACCES, ENOENT) when the system refused; usage for the command line; request for the document; error when nothing finer is known.

subject.description: What failed: the operand, the option, the resource.

message.description: The text a person reads: strerror(3) or the program's sentence, the same as the text form.
